text.description_html:
Stainless Steel Barn Door Kit For Additional Wood Door

This Stainless Steel 2nd Door Barn Door Kit comes packaged with everything you'll need to hang an additional door on an existing AHI Barn Door Track. Along with the anti-jump design that will keep the sliding door from easily falling off the track, the SIG500 kit includes a stainless steel ball bearing wheel assembly to ensure an ultra-smooth, nearly silent operation. This sliding door mounting kit has a satin stainless steel finish that will add a contemporary touch to your home. And since it is made out of stainless steel, you can be certain it is designed to withstand the test of time, just like the unfailing appeal of the barn door itself.

Features of the Sliding Barn Door Installation Kit:

  • Comes with all necessary hardware to install an additional barn door on the Stainless Steel Barn Door Kit.
  • All stainless steel construction.
  • Nylon covered wheel for silent operation.
  • Ball bering wheel for a long lasting, smooth operation.
  • Anti-jump wall mounting brackets.
  • The track-mounted door stops have rubber bumpers so they will not damage the doors.

Specifications of the Modern Stainless Steel Barn Door Hardware:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Track: 72" (6 feet)
  • Door Thickness Minimum: 1-3/16"
  • AHI SIG500-KIT Specifications Diagram (PDF)
  • AHI SIG500 Installation Guide (PDF)

Package Includes:

  • 2 Stainless Steel Roller Assemblies
  • 5 Stainless Steel Wall Mounts
  • 2 Stainless Steel Track End Caps
  • 2 Stainless Steel Door Stops
  • 1 Stainless Steel Floor Mounted Door Guide
  • All necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
